<?php
function gpc_get_string($name, $default = '') {

    return $default;
}

$filter = ensure_valid_filter($filter);

notes.sink: main/inc/lib/webservices/Rest.php:824-835 decodeParams() str_replace/base64_decode the string and return unserialize($b64Decoded); v2.php:8-12 then copies the returned array into $_REQUEST (PHP object injection)
notes.between: the request value is the only argument to Rest::decodeParams() and no format or type check precedes unserialize. The fix replaces the serialize/base64 pair with json_decode/json_encode and applies Security::remove_XSS to the restored values.
notes.fix: json_decode instead of unserialize(base64_decode()), plus Security::remove_XSS on the decoded values
notes.probe:
<?php
class Rest {
    public static function decodeParams($encoded) {
        $decoded = str_replace(['-', '_', '.'], ['+', '/', '='], $encoded);
        $mod4 = strlen($decoded) % 4;
        if ($mod4) { $decoded .= substr('====', $mod4); }
        return unserialize(base64_decode($decoded));
    }
}
$hash = $_REQUEST['hash'];
$params = Rest::decodeParams($hash);
foreach ($params as $key => $value) { $_REQUEST[$key] = $value; }
